releaseNotes: IMAGE CLICKER STABILITY: the crash on start (unguarded MediaProjection start-up) is fixed — any consent/OEM error now shows a retry state instead of killing the app. The 1080p stride bug that made the matcher see garbage frames is fixed too, so IF-IMAGE steps actually work on real screens. The pill can no longer strand; the engine stops honestly if the accessibility or capture service dies mid-run.

The Image Clicker is ALSO its own app now — Ophelia Image Clicker 1.0.0 (see the family list) with the same vision engine, plus a dedicated UI. If you only want the clicker, you no longer need the cloner.

TWO MORE NEW FAMILY APPS: Ophelia Browser 1.0.0 (Ophelia Search, tabs, add-ons + userscripts, ad-block, night mode) and Ophelia Auto Clicker 1.0.0 (the OP Auto Clicker classic — crosshair targets, intervals, swipes, floating bubble).

Family fix wave installed in place (same signing keys, update right over): pic-hider 2.0.2 (vault atomic saves, duress fix, big-video streaming), easypair 1.6.3 (socket leaks + timeouts + DoS caps), cool-widgets 2.0.2 (battery drain fix), junk-cleaner 2.0.2 (safety rails), fit 1.0.2, game-booster 1.0.2.

If Play Protect blocks the update (Harmful app blocked, no Install-anyway): Play Store, profile, Play Protect, gear, turn OFF Scan apps with Play Protect, tap Update again (Google's server-side verdict on re-signing cloners — the original App Cloner is flagged the same way). You can turn scanning back on afterwards.
switcherReleaseNotes: dex v6 unchanged in this release (crash fixes live in the cloner app + the new standalone Image Clicker).
